rationale.conceptual: The method is an established DFT protocol (GGA-PBE, spin-polarized calculations, DOS extraction) applied to known crystal structures. No new theory or algorithm is needed; implementing it requires typical solid-state computational skills.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of 3–4 straightforward DFT steps (structure setup, geometry optimization, electronic structure calculation, results compilation). It uses standard open-source tools without fragile orchestration or heavy data handling.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT workflow: spin-polarized GGA calculations of small supercells to determine half-metallicity. The work is methodologically routine in condensed matter physics, requiring no novel algorithms. The pipeline is sequential but not complex.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Supercells contain up to 8 atoms; moderate k-point grids (a few thousand) make the CPU-only DFT calculations lightweight, with peak memory well under 5 GB.
